description: This file defines an API endpoint class `AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI` within the OrangeHRM system, which checks for overlapping punch-out records during attendance record editing. It includes methods for handling GET requests, validating parameters, and interacting with attendance data services.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class enabling clients to check whether a punch-out record overlaps with existing attendance entries during record editing. Implements GET request handling, parameter validation, and interaction with attendance data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to verify punch out overlap for a specific attendance record based on provided parameters, returning a boolean indicating overlap status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
